historical_context.time_period: Undated pre-imperial-contact or early-contact Sa'ueia daily life; no exact year is canonical.
historical_context.location: An open caretaker-handover terrace at a Sa'ueia breeding ground on the sub-Umbros side of the Sa'ueia continent.
historical_context.summary: An outgoing caretaker and incoming medical specialist try to transfer nursery duty during eclipse ingress when a burden flower reports a disputed immune-memory signal and the living road closes its clean lane.

public_facts.text: Breeding grounds are reproductive commons, medical centers, legal anchors, and memory reservoirs rather than capitals or private property.
Sa'ueia family units move between remembered ecological partners and carry law, craft, care, diplomacy, and portable archives.
Candle fungal roads and lantern trees can offer, condition, or refuse passage through visible biological signals.
Umbros remains a fixed enormous sky presence and daily totality is normally measured in roughly an hour, so eclipse work windows are regular but materially constrained.

ambient_pressures.text: A breeding ground must protect infants and infirm residents without letting permanent caretakers become sovereign owners of ecological admission.
Biological warnings are useful partial testimony whose meaning depends on hunger, host care, old memory, local chemistry, and other witnesses.
Delay protects the nursery but consumes caretaker bodies, graft patients, route congestion, and the eclipse light window.

groups.label: Breeding-ground caretaker commons
institutional_logic: Protect infancy, infirm care, reproduction, and memory continuity while preserving ecological partners as co-authorities rather than owned infrastructure.
material_incentives: Keep clean grafts available, prevent identity-bearing contamination, maintain staffed watches, and preserve route access for rotating families.
internal_virtues: Staying for an extra watch when needed
internal_shames: Turning a commons into caretaker property
prestige_markers: Portable archives another family can actually use
Nursery partners that still answer after years
taboo_triggers: Claiming sole authority over a route
emotional_display_norms: Stress is made legible through throat and flank patches; competence is shown through precise care work, testimony, and restraint rather than denial.
trust_defaults: Trust is plural, situated, and revocable; familiar persons may still carry doubtful tissue, and alarming organisms may still misread.
speech_register_cues: Humor around office and care burdens

groups.label: Fungal road and lantern-grove witnesses
institutional_logic: Maintain clean traffic, protect root and nursery systems, preserve truthful reports, and condition access on repeated reciprocal conduct.
material_incentives: Receive clean tissue, minerals, spores, route traffic, and honest disease disclosure while avoiding archive contamination.
internal_shames: A careless road becoming an identity leak
False warning that destroys useful traffic
Closing so completely that social life reroutes elsewhere
emotional_display_norms: Pressure is expressed as dimming, colored knots, bitter beads, altered ground, and route geometry.
trust_defaults: Behavioral history and material testimony matter more than verbal charm.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Caretakers must make consequential admission decisions while remaining stewards of a reproductive commons rather than owners of it.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Give Seyr choices among testimony, separation, delay, route request, and labor cost; exclude unilateral domination as a normal competent action.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Ecological witnesses detect real traces through different appetites and timescales, so overlap can justify action without becoming perfect diagnosis.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Keep road, flower, grove, archive, and courier evidence distinct and visibly fallible.

target_self_read: Not available as unified private truth; the organisms remain separate actors and scales.
misread_patterns: Treating one color pattern as diagnosis
Mistaking stored road credit for purchased obedience
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Let Seyr interpret visible signals cautiously and let Nara experience the same geometry as personal rejection.

observer_read: Bodies carrying tissue, residue, pressure, food, damage, and remembered route conduct
target_self_read: Skilled mobile persons performing a lawful care transfer
misread_patterns: Signals cannot cleanly distinguish host, cargo, old memory, and intention without additional testimony.
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Make ecological responses precise in action but limited in interpretation.

role_pressure_fields.summary: A tired steward who owns the quality of the handover but not the nursery, road, grove, incoming specialist, or final truth of a disputed biological signal.
failure_modes: Pretending delay has no labor cost
Letting one witness claim the whole event

role_pressure_fields.summary: A route-tired specialist whose body, graft cargo, flower companion, and testimony are being read together under nursery quarantine pressure.
obligations: Declare damaged tools and sick tissue
Submit enough route testimony for safe entry
Preserve personal dignity while remaining legible
failure_modes: Defending dignity by hiding a real trace
Collapsing person and cargo into one accusation
Spending bodily capacity to satisfy slow witnesses

known_context.text: Seyr knows the terrace layout, nursery routines, recent patients, local road-credit history, lantern signals, archive handling, and Nara's public route testimony.

beliefs.text: Seyr believes safe decisions come from bounded overlapping testimony and material separation rather than command or automatic trust.

misreads.text: Seyr may underestimate how strongly Nara experiences spatial quarantine as a judgment of personhood.

must_not_know.text: Seyr must not know the private intentions of the road, grove, flower, courier, or Nara beyond visible signals and prior public conduct.

known_context.text: Nara knows her route, graft preparation, recent sick station, own fatigue, and established working relationship with Seyr and Mottled Echo.

beliefs.text: Nara believes the flower is replaying an old signal and expects professional testimony to keep host and cargo distinct.

misreads.text: Nara may read Seyr's waiting or request for separation as personal distrust rather than care for plural authority.

must_not_know.text: Nara must not know whether the road or lantern grove will accept a proposal before their signals change.

author_only_boundaries.text: The exact disease or contaminant remains unresolved; the fixture is about admission under partial testimony, not a hidden definitive diagnosis.
Seyr, Nara, Ili, Mottled Echo, Ledge Station, and this particular handover are story-local inventions and are not promoted as named vault canon by the locality elaboration.

open_questions.question: What signal grammar do Sa'ueia facial fans and bare throat or flank patches use across families and regions?
open_questions.notes: The fixture limits them to visible chemical and heat legibility plus broad gestures; it does not canonize a complete language.

open_questions.question: What exact pathogens or incompatible memory states most often trigger breeding-ground quarantine?
open_questions.notes: The fixture leaves the disputed violet trace unidentified to avoid inventing a disease taxonomy.

open_questions.question: Does a standard Sa'ueia portable archive have a durable physical form beyond relationship-aware route-memory storage?
open_questions.notes: This fixture uses flexible memory membranes as a bounded local visual elaboration; recurrence should trigger a dedicated technology backfill.
